finalClaimSheetAddition: For counties without direct legacy DB access, TerraFusion defines a governed County Data Intake Lane for assessor-provided exports, GIS packages, spreadsheets, and source packets. The MVP creates receipts, validates county/FIPS binding, screens unsafe material, produces rejected-row and dry-run reports, and requires human approval. It does not write to canonical production tables.
